hypothesis: Existing trend_long candidates have higher expectancy when at least 75% of the current feature-complete universe is above its 200-day average, so a trend-only risk multiplier may improve EV without adding tickers, filters, exits, or ranking rules.

alpha_hypothesis.why_this_now: LLM soft-ranking remains sample-limited; event/universe promotion lacks same-day replacement evidence; recent slot-ranking, broad rotation, high-dispersion, SEC, options, and event-runner variants were rejected. This tests a deterministic state-conditioned capital allocation variable on existing production candidates.

similar_prior_results.exp-20260427-025: Rejected simple universe-breadth thresholds for scarce-slot breakout deferral; this run does not alter deferral or slots.
similar_prior_results.exp-20260429-030: Observed that broad 200-day breadth cohorts were strong, but did not test an executable risk allocation.
similar_prior_results.exp-20260503-010_and_exp-20260506-019: Rejected candidate ranking; this run leaves order unchanged.
similar_prior_results.exp-20260506-028_to_032: Avoids nearby SPY-leader, broad-rotation, high-dispersion, mid-dispersion breakout, and accepted mid-dispersion trend rules.

historical_experiment_check.why_not_simple_repeat: The only tested variable is a trend-only sizing multiplier under existing 200-day universe participation; it does not gate entries, unlock slots, add tickers, or retune SPY-relative leader logic.
historical_experiment_check.mechanism_insight_conflict: none identified after playbook and logs review

acceptance_rule_result: Gate 4 failed: best variant raised aggregate PnL but did not clear the north-star EV threshold and worsened risk quality, so it does not justify another breadth-conditioned sizing rule.

llm_metrics.blocker_relation: LLM soft-ranking data is sparse, so this run used a deterministic OHLCV breadth allocation alpha instead.

risk_note: May over-allocate to late-cycle broad participation where trend signals are already crowded; this is why all exits, filters, and ranking stayed locked.
